about: The Collect recalls Stanislaus’s death for God’s honor. It asks that those invoking the bishop-martyr’s aid obtain the saving result of their petition.

seg.tr: God, the glorious bishop Stanislaus died by the swords of the ungodly for Your honor. Grant, we pray, that all who invoke his help may receive the saving result of their own petition. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: by the swords of the ungodly
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w003: The honor is God’s, not Stanislaus’s own honor.
ex.w009: The word names impious people whose swords caused the saint’s death. It does not describe the swords as impious.
ex.w016: “His” refers to Stanislaus, while “their own” later refers to the people invoking his aid.
ex.w022: The requested result is saving, not the unrestricted fulfillment of any desire. The earlier phrase “of their own petition” belongs to this result.
ex.w040: The word “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
